title: Verify whether an empty extraction may replace saved evidence.
comment:
**Verify whether an empty extraction may replace saved evidence.**

If `extract_notes()` accepts an empty `notes` list, `rows` is empty but `_import()` still deactivates the previous version and saves a zero-passage version. Subsequent searches lose the previous evidence. Check whether an empty extraction means an intentional replacement or an abstention; if it means abstention, reject it before `_import()`.

title: Expose observation provenance instead of presenting a generated filename.
comment:
**Expose observation provenance instead of presenting a generated filename.**

This path is an internal identifier, not an imported note. `search()` returns it without the observation’s `source` or `route`, and the browser displays its basename as the evidence filename. Observation results therefore appear to cite a `.md` file that was never imported. Return the observation provenance with search hits and display it as an observation. title: Verify that observation imports enforce the note policy.
comment:
**Verify that observation imports enforce the note policy.**

`import_observation()` does not call `NotePolicy.decode()`. If `extract_notes()` does not apply equivalent checks, text containing `neurobrain: do-not-store` or a detected credential can reach `_import()` and be stored as a passage. Inspect that function’s checks; otherwise, validate the text with `NotePolicy.decode()` before extraction.
